description: A plum court gown has a low square neckline, fitted bodice, shaped elbow sleeves and a floor-length skirt with a narrow below-knee opening. Gold woven geometric borders trim the neckline, front, cuffs, hem and belt, which has a round metal clasp. An ivory wrap edged in gold rests around both forearms. Small earrings, rings and dark shoes with gold embroidery are visible.
